name: foreign / unknown / malformed field -> 404/400, no capture row created
date/cloud validation: from>=to, >90 days, future end, naive timestamp, cloud -1/101/NaN/"x"/true, unknown props, null body fields
REAL Sentinel Hub: create scan (30-day window, <=30% cloud) -> 202 QUEUED, DB capture + outbox row
REAL pipeline: beat outbox -> Celery -> STAC catalog search -> raster process -> terminal state (up to 5 min)
indices NDVI/EVI/NDWI: values in physical range, valid-pixel coverage reported, stored in DB, matches API
layers: owner gets authenticated same-origin URLs; content is a real PNG/TIFF; B gets 404; traversal / unknown type 404
farmer B cannot read A scan, statistics, layers, list; A list excludes B
idempotency: second scan of the same window/field does not duplicate an already published scene (NO_VALID_SCENE, 1 completed capture per scene)
cloud filter honesty: maxCloudCoverage=0 on a 3-day window yields NO_VALID_SCENE/CLOUD_BLOCKED (no stats fabricated)
empty state: field with no captures -> [] list and comparison INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY
boundary change after capture: comparison excludes captures with a different geometry hash (no false trend)
detail: observations before=2 after-move=2 basis=PREVIOUS_VALID_OBSERVATION (captures keep their own geometry hash)

name: rate limit: >10 satellite requests/hour per farmer -> 429
web BFF satellite (browser contract): authenticated list + scan JSON reachable through Next
REAL provider outage (Earth Search STAC host unreachable from the worker) -> bounded retries -> FAILED with sanitised code, no statistics, no provider URL/secret leak
recovery: after worker restored, new scan processes again (queue not poisoned)
two scans on one field submitted back-to-back: both reach a terminal state promptly (no 15-minute stall)
detail: after 150 s states=COMPLETED/QUEUED (second task returned ALREADY_RUNNING and its outbox row was pushed 15 minutes ahead)
